description_en: Retrieves the details of a site by its ID
description_zh: 根据站点ID查询单个站点信息
name: GetSite

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: site_id

AccessType.description_en:
The access type of the site. Valid values:

NS: Access via NS.

CNAME: Access via CNAME
AccessType.description_zh:
站点接入类型。取值：

NS：通过NS接入。
CNAME：通过CNAME接入

CnameZone.description_en: For sites onboarded via CNAME, use this suffix to configure the CNAME record
CnameZone.description_zh: 站点的CNAME后缀。通过CNAME方式接入的站点，记录所需要配置CNAME的后缀

Coverage.description_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

domestic: Chinese mainland only

global: Global

overseas: Global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
Coverage.description_zh:
加速区域。取值：
domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）

CreateTime.description_en: The time (in UTC) when the site was created, formatted in ISO 8601 (`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`)
CreateTime.description_zh: 站点的创建时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the plan instance

NameServerList.description_en: A comma-separated list of name servers assigned to the site
NameServerList.description_zh: 站点分配的NS列表。使用半角逗号（,）分隔

OfflineReason.description_en:
The reason the site is offline. This parameter appears only when `Status` is `offline`. Valid values:

expiration_arrears: The subscription plan has expired or the account has overdue payments.

internally_disabled: The site was disabled by the system.

missing_icp: The domain is missing an ICP license.

content_violation: The site violated content policies.

proactively_disabled: The site was disabled either by you or by a usage limit that you configured
OfflineReason.description_zh:
站点停用原因。取值：

expiration_ arrears：订阅套餐到期或账号欠费。
internally_disabled：被系统内部停用。
missing_icp：域名缺少ICP。
content_violation：内容违规。
proactively_disabled：您主动停用或您设置的用量封顶停用

PlanSpecName.description_en: The name of the plan specification

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

Status.description_en:
The status of the site. Valid values:

pending: The site is pending configuration.

active: The site is active.

offline: The site is offline.

moved: The site has been superseded
Status.description_zh:
站点状态。取值：

pending：站点待配置。
active：站点已激活。
offline：站点已下线。
moved：站点已被顶替

UpdateTime.description_en: The time (in UTC) when the site was last updated, formatted in ISO 8601 (`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`)
UpdateTime.description_zh: 站点的更新时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

additionalProperties.description_en: The name of a custom name server

VanityNSList.description_en: Each key is a custom name server, and its value is a comma-separated list of the server's IP addresses
VanityNSList.description_zh: 站点的自定义NS信息，键为单个自定义NS名称，值为自定义NS对应的Ip地址列表，Ip地址列表用半角逗号（,）分隔

VerifyCode.description_en: For sites onboarded via CNAME, you must configure this code as a TXT record
VerifyCode.description_zh: 站点归属校验码。当站点通过CNAME接入时，需要配置的TXT校验码

VersionManagement.description_en: If `true`, version management is enabled for the site
VersionManagement.description_zh: 版本管理开启状态。为true时代表站点开启了版本管理
